script: With a starting price of $55K and now trading for about $86.5K, this one appreciates like few modern cars. Demand pushed production from a limited run to 6,309 units, making the 2011 BMW 1M a cult classic. Powering the 1M is a 3.0L twin-turbo straight-six engine generating 335 hp and 332 lb-ft of torque. The BMW 1M sprints from zero to sixty in just 4.7 seconds, making it famous for its thrilling dynamics and enduring appeal. Inside, the M badge on the steering wheel signals the performance lineage of the 1 Series M Coupe. The sporty quad exhaust tips on the rear emphasize the BMW 1M's dedication to performance. With turbo power and edgy looks, does the 1M deserve its hype as a modern classic?

sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2011 BMW 1M, finished in Black Sapphire Metallic with a black interior. Cars & Bids managing editor Kennan Rolsen reviewed this 1M, and the video is viewable below. This 1M is equipped with a 6-speed manual transmission, and its odometer currently displays about 2,900 miles. The attached Carfax history report contains some gaps, though it shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this BMW's past; it also lists registrations in California from new. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, factory equipment includes the Navigation Assist, Premium 2, and Convenience packages, 19-inch Style 359M wheels, a variable M differential lock, an M-specific suspension system, xenon headlights, Boston leather upholstery, heated front sport seats, a Harman/Kardon sound system, and more as listed below. The only modification reported by the selling dealer is a set of black kidney grilles. The M version of BMW's 1 Series coupe, called E82 internally, was intended to be a limited-production model but it proved popular enough to warrant tripling the original production quota to just over 6,300 units. Its turbocharged engine was a polarizing departure from previous M cars, as was its funky styling — and yet, the 1M has gained a substantial and loyal following since production ended in 2012. Power comes from a 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged straight-6, rated at 335 horsepower and 332 lb-ft of torque. Called N54T internally, it spins the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual transmission.
sections.Equipment: A window sticker is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment includes: Premium 2 Package (auto-dimming mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, lumbar support, ambient lighting) Convenience Package (anti-theft alarm system, Comfort Access keyless entry, rear parking sensors) Navigation Assist Package (Navigation Assist and BMW Assist with enhanced Bluetooth and USB, hands-free Bluetooth and USB) 19-inch Style 359M wheels M-specific suspension system Variable M differential lock Xenon headlights with washers Boston Leather upholstery Orange contrast stitching Heated front sport seats Alcantara interior trim Dual-zone automatic climate control Harman/Kardon surround sound system Cruise control
sections.Seller Notes: The selling dealer notes that the underside of the front bumper has been refinished to address some scuffs. The selling dealer charges a $195 documentation fee to the winning bidder. Please contact the seller directly with any questions.
